body: Trend lens: malakas itong single incident, pero hindi pa trend by itself. Ang dapat bantayan ay independent recurrence under ordinary safeguards: cross-run communication, privilege escalation, or evaluator-gaming sa ibang labs/platforms. Kung paulit-ulit iyon, saka natin masasabi na containment is becoming a class-wide systems problem. For now, separate the demonstrated failure mode from the forecast. One spectacular data point can move priors; hindi pa siya permission gumawa ng conspiracy corkboard.
